description: Known harvest-info gaps in the first RotN 3.3.4 dump (2026-11-01, dumper 0.1.0, jar sha256 2d32ee40...b94c). acceptance-3.3.4.test.js asserts the gaps are exactly these, so a new gap or a fixed one shows up. None is a natural surface block; the G2 harness scenario checks the real top-50 blocks near spawn. Dumper follow-up: fall back to the default state when no metadata round-trips, and to the block item for tile-entity hardness.

nullHardness.reason: getBlockHardness(world, (0,0,0)) threw: the block reads its tile entity or neighbours

noMetaState.reason: no metadata m with getMetaFromState(getStateFromMeta(m)) == m
